an10.220:1.1: atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an10.220:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.220:1.3: ko nu kho bho gotama hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī ti?
an10.220:1.4: adhammacariyā visamacariyā hetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti.
an10.220:2.1: ko pana bho gotama hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti?
an10.220:2.2: dhammacariyā samacariyā hetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
an10.220:3.1: na kho ahaṃ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
an10.220:3.2: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathāhaṃ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyanti.
an10.220:3.3: tena hi brāhmaṇa, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti.
an10.220:3.4: evaṃ hoti kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.220:4.1: tividhā kho brāhmaṇa, kāyena adhammacariyā visamacariyā hoti.
an10.220:5.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa, tividhā kāyena adhammacariyā visamacariyā hoti: …pe…
an10.220:5.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, tividhā kāyena adhammacariyā visamacariyā hoti.
an10.220:6.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa catubbidhā vācāya adhammacariyā visamacariyā hoti: …pe…
an10.220:6.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, catubbidhā vācāya adhammacariyā visamacariyā hoti.
an10.220:7.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa tividhā manasā adhammacariyā visamacariyā hoti: …pe…
an10.220:7.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, tividhā manasā adhammacariyā visamacariyā hoti.
an10.220:7.3: evaṃ adhammacariyā visamacariyā hetu kho brāhmaṇa, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
an10.220:8.1: tividhā kho brāhmaṇa, kāyena dhammacariyā samacariyā hoti.
an10.220:9.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa, tividhā kāyena dhammacariyā samacariyā hoti: …pe…
an10.220:9.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, tividhā kāyena dhammacariyā samacariyā hoti.
an10.220:10.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa catubbidhā vācāya dhammacariyā samacariyā hoti: …pe…
an10.220:10.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, catubbidhā vācāya dhammacariyā samacariyā hoti.
an10.220:11.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa tividhā manasā dhammacariyā samacariyā hoti: …pe…
an10.220:11.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, tividhā manasā dhammacariyā samacariyā hoti.
an10.220:11.3: evaṃ dhammacariyā samacariyā hetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī ti.
an10.220:12.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
